definition: σφραγίζω  [in LXX chiefly for חָתַם (Deu.32:34, al.), also for סָתַם (Da TH Dan.8:26) ;] to seal,  __(a) for security: Mat.27:66, Rev.20:3; τ. καρπὸν τοῦτον, figuratively (cf. Deiss., BS, 238 f.; MM, xxiv; DB, iv, 427a), Rom.15:28;  __(b) for concealment, hence, metaphorically, to hide (Da TH Dan.9:24, Jhn.14:17):  Rev.10:4 22:10;  __(with) for distinction, Rev.7:3-8; metaphorically, Eph.4:30; mid., 2Co.1:22;  __(d) for authentication (Est.8:8): Jhn.3:33 6:27 (cf. κατα-σφραγίζω).† (AS)
